proposals.name: 經典人形
proposals.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high-fidelity design proposal for a resizable read-only teammate equipment floating window in a classic PC Lineage idle game, Traditional Chinese. Create one front-on portrait UI reference with the complete window visible. Art direction must closely match original early-2000s Lineage interface artwork: black and weathered charcoal stone, muted olive iron and aged bronze trim, thin sculpted corner ornaments, subtle worn material texture, warm ivory text, restrained amber selected tabs, original-style small pixel-art item icons, gold and blue item enchant glows. Rich layered craftsmanship with compact readable spacing. This must feel like the original Lineage character/equipment interface. Title 隊友裝備. Anonymous character only 法師甲（法師）Lv.40. Tabs 能力 / 裝備, 裝備 selected. Preserve two page buttons 裝備 1 / 裝備 2. Represent real ordinary equipment slot types: 頭盔、耳環、項鍊、手套、斗篷、內衣、武器、盾牌、盔甲、戒指、腰帶、臂甲、鞋子、娃娃、箭矢, with repeated earrings and rings where needed. Filled slots show original-looking icons, E badge and +7/+4 enchant values; empty slots stay clearly identifiable. Include one small classic hover information panel for +7 瑪那魔杖, without invented stats. Read-only, no equip/sell/upgrade actions. Designed to remain usable when the window narrows or becomes shorter; do not depend on oversized fixed artwork. Verbatim Taiwan Traditional Chinese text, single-line labels. Avoid white cards, flat modern dashboards, neon, glassmorphism, oversized rounded chips, new logos, watermark, real player identifiers. A concept reference; do not add unsupported gameplay systems.
Proposal A — Classic paper-doll equipment composition. A moderately sized original-style male mage sprite or painted character silhouette in the central third, anatomical equipment slots around it in a compact symmetrical arrangement, head and jewelry above, weapon and shield flanking, armor centered, rings/belt/boots below. Character takes at most one third of usable panel height. Match the old native equipment sheet's spatial logic, with elaborate but restrained original Lineage bronze/olive metal frame and dark recessed squares. No giant full-body background. Richer than a plain icon grid, readable in a modest portrait floating window. A · 經典人形 appears as a small reference caption.
